summary: Zim is a graphical text editor designed for managing collections of wiki pages. It allows you to organise notes locally with simple formatting, embedded images, and hyperlinks between pages.
goodFor: It suits users who want a desktop-centric personal knowledge base rather than a collaborative web-based wiki service.
watchOut: The software relies on local desktop packages and lacks native multi-user collaboration features found in modern web-based alternatives.
deployNotes: Because it is distributed as a Python and Debian package, you will typically install it directly on a local desktop environment rather than a headless server with a reverse proxy.
